text:
QUOTE: "Split the pattern at its first `:` into a tool part and an optional argument part. - The tool part is `fnmatch`ed against the fully-qualified tool name, e.g. `filesystem.read_file`. - With no `:`, the tool match is enough."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states fnmatch matching, the split at the first colon into tool and argument parts, and that a pattern with no colon matches on the tool name alone.
